rho_reference.band_basis: the row's reported arm at its largest size (icv1-f2m61-t158598901-ab42b6c5, 2^47.2), against the measured rho; the index calculus is timed by the clock, so it carries no unpriced native work; the canonicalisations rho's walk leaves uncharged (median 1534750.5 a process) are priced at 0, 0.1 and 1 GAE each
rho_reference.binary_or_process: the row's own `ic` binary and process: both arms rebuilt from nothing each repetition, the index calculus first
rho_reference.protocol: ledger section 23's one-target rho on the same public point, in the same `ic price --single-target` process: the signed-Frobenius r-adding walk (negation and Frobenius classes), its set-up plus its walk, as measured

rho_canonical_step_model.note: not a reference: rho's counted walk priced at the canonical batched step the process measures, a model beside the measured interval (the record's `rho_model`); rule v8's measured matched rho sits between it and rho as built

rho_reference.strongest_available_basis: the gate's sense (docs/VALIDATION_GATE.md): the strongest symmetry fold for the curve, here negation and Frobenius (A = 2n). Implementations of that walk differ in speed: rule v8's matched rho, batched canonicalisation, measured 1.30-1.58x faster cold than rho as at v7 on the same binary
rho_reference.unit: S: cold time in v0's unit (one batched addition) over sqrt(r)
